picks.title: Khosla-backed robotics startup Genesis AI has gone full stack, demo shows
picks.why_it_matters: A $105M seed round for foundational robotics AI signals major investor conviction in embodied AI as the next platform shift—watch for adjacent opportunities in simulation, sensors, and manipulation software.

picks.title: DeepSeek could hit $45B valuation from its first investment round
picks.why_it_matters: DeepSeek's efficient training approach validates that compute cost advantages can disrupt incumbents—creating openings for startups building on cheaper, capable open-weight models rather than relying on expensive API providers.

picks.title: A 20-minute pitch wins Indian startup Pronto backing from Lachy Groom
picks.why_it_matters: Pronto's 26K daily bookings and an $18B TAM in India's travel sector highlight high-velocity consumer marketplaces emerging in India as a compelling early-stage hunting ground.
